assumptions.combined_usd_net: conditional on USDG=USDC=USD parity; conversion and transfer not modeled
assumptions.dust: below-minimum hedge or exit remains unresolved; reduce-only exceptions not assumed
assumptions.fee_tier: public base rates, no user volume/staking/referral/builder adjustments
assumptions.funding: hour-crossing exposure unresolved without sourced settlement cash
assumptions.initial_wallet_per_venue: 2 * branch budget; separate USDG and USDC wallets
assumptions.private_fills: not observed; every maker fill is a counterfactual public-flow scenario
assumptions.promotion: 20-minute holdout is descriptive feasibility only; no production promotion
assumptions.timing: public-book timing proxies; source clocks are not calibrated private execution clocks

branches.cash_accounting_note: Synthetic perp entry/exit notional cash-flow ledger; not live wallet balances. At flat, per-venue cash is modeled realized P&L in that venue's quote unit.
branches.fee_only_note: Known flat synthetic cash after four actual-notional venue fees; excludes conversion, financing, and the separate 5 bp reserve.
branches.net_unit_note: Combined net assumes USDG=USDC; executable conversion is unmodeled.
branches.stressed_note: Fee-only cash less 5 bp reserve and modeled 5% annual capital charge; undefined when funding, execution, or quote obligations are unknown.

limitations: Only same-entry known-complete episodes enter paired cash comparisons.
Unsettled, funding-unknown, and execution-unknown paths have unknown net.
Public flow is conditional queue attribution, not private fills.
Counterfactual portfolios share events and must not be summed.
